crew.overview: A tribute to the controversial black activist and leader of the struggle for black liberation. He hit bottom during his imprisonment in the '50s, he became a Black Muslim and then a leader in the Nation of Islam. His assassination in 1965 left a legacy of self-determination and racial pride.

details.biography: Malcolm D. Lee  (born January 11, 1970) is an American filmmaker and author. He has directed such films as Undercover Brother, The Best Man, Roll Bounce, Welcome Home Roscoe Jenkins, and Soul Men. He is the cousin of filmmaker Spike Lee, and is a graduate of Packer Collegiate Institute and Georgetown University.
